messages:
marta: heads-up: during a manual drain of gpu-pool-usw2-spot one of our model pods got evicted and ended up stuck on the cpu-only pool. looks like tolerations didn't propagate to the new warmup node. logs below.

 devon: are you seeing the taint on the warmup nodes? what does `kubectl get nodes --show-labels` show?

 devon: pasted: `gpu=true` nodes: gpu-pool-usw2-spot-123 Ready   labels: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=g5,redwood/taint-version=v3

 devon: warmup node: gpu-warmup-xyz Ready   labels: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=g5-warmup,redwood/taint-version=v2

 devon: toleration on pod was for `redwood/gpu-pool=v3:NoSchedule` so it didn't match v2 -> scheduler placed it on cpu pool (no taint match), then autoscaler backfilled with a node lacking the newer taint.

 marta: yup. sequence was: drain kicked -> drain annotated -> CA added warmup node -> kube-scheduler bound pod -> node had old taint version. result: model pod landed on wrong pool and later got evicted when real gpu node came up.

 samir: hmm. this is the `taint-version` roll-forward problem we've seen in staging. two quick mitigations: 1) make toleration match prefix with `Exists` if safe, or 2) add a preflight admission check on pod create to reject mismatched tolerations. also consider marking warmup nodes with `redwood/warmup=true` and use nodeAffinity to prefer, not require.

 kai: filing an upstream-ish bug: seems kube-controller-manager sometimes re-applies taints from launch template after ASG/nodegroup patches, so taint-version drift can happen during scale events. I'll open a GH issue with diffs and logs.

 infra-bot: [nodepool-service] gpu-pool-usw2-spot: scaling event detected +2 nodes at 2024-11-01T14:02Z

 marta: pragmatic short-term fix: update the autoscaler/launch template to add the latest `redwood/taint-version=v3` label/taint on warmup instances. long-term: prefer toleration `Exists` with admission guard or runtime check.

 devon: i'll roll a tiny admission webhook that checks toleration key + value consistency vs nodepool config. sketch:
 ```
 if pod.spec.tolerations contains key redwood/gpu-pool:
   if value != nodepool.expected_version:
     reject
 ```

 samir: also add a metric `taint_mismatch_count` and alert if > 5/min in a region during scale events.

 marta: action items: devon - webhook PR; kai - GH issue + k8s repro; infra - patch ASG images to include v3 taint for warmup; samir - alert rule. :thumbsup:

 kai: note: will also try a taint reconcile controller that enforces desired taints on nodes after they join, cheaper than changing launch images across clouds.

 devon: PR in progress, will link once ready. thanks all.
